data.name: Consent.Info
data.value: Hi kombela u hlawula xiyimo xa mpfumelelano xa murimi xaku tirhisiwa ka swifaniso, u tlhela u nyika nsayino wa vona la hansi.

data.name: Consent.Full.Description
data.value: Minga tirhisa xifaniso xa Mina mi tlhela mi boxa na Vito ra mina.

data.name: Consent.Limited.Description
data.value: Minga tirhisa xifaniso xa Mina eka swifaniso swa ntlawa handle ko boxa Vito ra Mina.

data.name: Consent.None.Description
data.value: A mi fanelanga ku tirhisa xifaniso xa Mina hi ndlela yihi kumbe yihi.

data.name: Signature.Info
data.value: Kombela u nyika kusayina ku tiyisisa nhlayo leyi hlawulekeke ya nvumelano

data.name: Signature.Help
data.value: Dirowa kusayina ka wena hi xivomba xa wena kumbe mouse

data.name: Signature.Confirm
data.value: Ndzi tiyisisa leswaku xiyimo lexi xa mpfumelelano xi hlamuseriwile na swona xi pfumeleriwile hi murimi.
